question: The population of a district is 372000, out of which 168000 are males. 20% of the population is literate. If 20% males are literate, then what percentage of females are literate?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By the rule of weighted averages, if an overall group and one of its sub-groups share the exact same percentage, the other sub-group must also have that same percentage.

Overall population literacy = 20%

Male population literacy = 20%

⇒ Female population literacy must also be exactly 20% without any further calculation.

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total population = 372000

Number of males = 168000

Overall literacy rate = 20%

Male literacy rate = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Part value ÷ Total value) × 100
